identity.title: [v0.91.7][review-fix][runtime-v3][security] Resolve #5247 state authenticity and readiness findings

review_prompts: Can any checkpoint field be altered without signature failure?
Can a validly signed but unaccepted or wrong-lineage record be projected?
Does the scheduled lane execute the real ignored soak rather than a retained packet assertion?
Is the LoC disposition reproducible, owned, and bounded?

findings.summary: Signed checkpoint fields changed the wire contract without advancing the checkpoint schema or defining legacy-v1 behavior.
The soak wrapper could accept stale or semantically invalid report evidence after a successful command exit.

residual_risk: Runtime v3 remains above the 10,000-line target at 12,034 physical Rust source lines; the bounded exception and v0.91.8 reduction ownership remain explicit.
